denominator_context: 108 professionally active Polish nurses aged approximately 45-55 years
model: Multivariable logistic regression for MetS components
caution: The source table reports the OR and significance marker but no confidence interval. Cross-sectional, small volunteer sample; physical activity self-reported. Do not infer an unreported CI.

denominator_context: 1,758 nurses from a tertiary medical center; MetS prevalence 13.84%
model: Source-reported logistic association between burnout and MetS
caution: Cross-sectional association; burnout and MetS measured contemporaneously. Do not interpret as incident risk or causal effect.

denominator_context: 751 employees of a Spanish environmental-services company
model: Linear regression adjusted for age, sex, alcohol consumption and global physical activity
caution: Cross-sectional study; OPA assigned from occupational categories rather than direct accelerometry. Global physical activity adjustment does not isolate leisure activity perfectly.
